_readme: The editor's sources. Articles written by the editor may use ONLY the outlets named in editor_list (they are defined in data/sources.json), the official website of the company the article is about (when the headline names it), entries here with kind 'company', and 'market data' (share-price tables, for prices, closes and percentage changes only; they never count toward the rule 'one official source or two different outlets'). editor_list holds only sources proven readable by both the chat desk and the site's robot. AI-written articles use data/sources.json alone. To add an outlet to editor_list, first check that the chat desk and the robot can both read it. The About page shows this list automatically.
